name: stackfoundry
description: Casts a repo-grounded swarm of specialists for each stack in your repo, for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor and Gemini CLI: code writers, verifiers, test designers and writers, bug hunters, fix verifiers, security and performance reviewers, dependency bumpers and a scheduled tech radar.

plugins.name: stackfoundry
plugins.description: Studies your repo, researches each language and app model from current sources, and generates grounded rulebooks and target profiles that drive generic role agents and orchestrator skills.
